sources.title: Pinned d3rlpy episode, transition and test semantics

local_copy.anchor: Pinned d3rlpy episode, transition and test semantics

inspected_anchors: Pinned d3rlpy episode, transition and test semantics
supported_claims: Episode boundary, retained transition and source-test observations
Episode distinguishes terminated from truncated transition count; compute_return sums stored rewards without discount.
Overlapping flags prioritize terminal by mutating timeout entries; no boundary raises; unclosed final tail is not emitted.
Basic picker sets interval one; multistep picker discounts by row offsets; terminal successor zero padding is explicit.
Overlap test parameter sets timeout flags but never sets terminal flags in that branch; no native test run.
Selected tests check terminal and multistep conversion examples; not a bank-data target oracle.

limitations: Selected pinned source inspection and exact authored algebra; no d3rlpy import, fit or upstream test run.
This decision does not establish whole-package correctness, installed compatibility, full dependency rights or maintained service.
Project amounts, transitions and error laws are stipulated scenarios, not empirical bank value or measured software failure rates.
Cutoff is 2026-10-07 Asia/Shanghai; saved historical metadata and exact commit are distinguished from current maintenance claims.
Reference use is selected; a public/generated prototype must resolve the specified semantics before enabling an adapter.
Whole-manuscript depth, wider software coverage, sponsor and rendered visual acceptance remain open.

sources.title: Pinned d3rlpy learner, FQE, metric and reward source

local_copy.anchor: Pinned d3rlpy learner, FQE, metric and reward source

inspected_anchors: Pinned d3rlpy learner, FQE, metric and reward source
supported_claims: Specific policy, metric population and reward-scale semantics
FQE configuration defaults and target-policy object are separate; ensemble count is not a confidence procedure.
FQE calls predict_best_action and uses gamma raised to batch interval; it does not integrate sampled policy actions in this update.
InitialStateValueEstimationEvaluator averages the first state of every batch, not just each episode; average-value and SoftOPC summaries have distinct targets.
Discrete CQL config declares a conservative penalty and DoubleDQN backbone; no banking value guarantee is inferred.
Discrete conservative loss is log-sum-exp minus logged-action value added to TD loss.
Clipping destroys magnitude information; affine reward inverse is one-step; return-based denominator can be zero without a guard in this path.
FQE tests use dummy encoders and generic tester with selected copy checks disabled; no performance or coverage finding inferred.
Public predict and sample_action differ; predict_value applies observation/action transformations but no inverse reward transformation.
